tasks.instruction_text: Find **condos for rent** in Houston that are **Pets allowed** — apply the Home Type (Condo) and Amenity (Pets allowed) chips. Both should appear in the applied-pill row above the map.

Mirror the Apartments.com request: a **Condo** in Houston for **monthly rent ≤ $2,000**, pets-allowed. Apply Condo + Pets-allowed chips + the rent band $0–$2,000. Verify all three pills sit in the applied row before reading off matches.
Apply **Condo** (home type) + **Pets allowed** (amenity) + **Available now** (listing status) + $0–$2,000 rent. Then × off the Available-now chip so listing status is unconstrained.
Cross-compare two home types: apply **Condo** AND **Townhouse** under Home Type, plus **Pets allowed** amenity. Then × off the Townhouse chip so the applied row shows Condo + Pets-allowed only.
No filters — how many listings total on ApartmentFind right now?
Without filtering, which listing has the highest rating, and what's its rating?
No filters — count listings priced under $2,000/month versus $2,000-and-up.
Apply the **Condo** (home type) chip AND the **Pets allowed** (amenity) chip. After both pills sit in the applied row, tell me how many pet-friendly condos are listed.

Multi-step replay: apply **Condo** + **Pets allowed** + $0–$2,000 rent + **Greystar** property manager. Then × off the Greystar chip so manager is unconstrained. Tell me how many pet-friendly condos under $2,000 remain.
Apply **Condo** + **Pets allowed** + the $0–$2,000 rent band. Once all three pills are docked, name the cheapest pet-friendly condo under $2K (title + rent).
